'''''Sealed to the Flame''''' is the title of two different chapters in ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series:

* The [[A Crown of Swords/Chapter 32|thirty-second chapter]] of ''[[A Crown of Swords]]''.
* The [[The Gathering Storm/Chapter 43|forty-third chapter]] of ''[[The Gathering Storm]]''.

It can also refers to [[Tower law#General|information]] meant only for the [[Amyrlin Seat]].
